source: IP-01 plan, Appendix C: allowed dependencies between workspace crates
reading: An edge between two workspace crates is allowed only if a rule below names it, with its kind (normal or dev). Every other edge fails layering_is_one_way. Nothing inside the workspace depends on `build-log` (the facade), so no rule has it as a target. A rule with optional = true says the dependency must be optional, behind a feature. The test kit depends on no workspace crate, so no rule starts at it. Third-party dependencies are not governed here.
